# Locally distributed OCR resources

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 are distributed under Apache-2.0; original license texts and the worker's bundled notices are included here. Their corresponding package sources are available at <https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js> and <https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core>.

Simplified Chinese and English LSTM language data are distributed via @tesseract.js-data/chi_sim and @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (package metadata: MIT), using their `4.0.0_best_int` traineddata. See <https://github.com/naptha/tessdata> and <https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best> for original language data and license information.

PDF.js resources retain the license files provided in their versioned asset directories. Public fictional font fixtures are test-only and include their ARPHIC license and dated modification notice; no user fonts or documents are distributed.
